Every tool the agent has, grouped by what it's for, and how the tools depend on and feed each other.

How to read this: color = capability family. Rounded boxes are tools, hexagons are rules and fields, chevrons are the agent's loop. Solid arrows: must happen first. Dashed: passes data. Dotted with a dot: checks the result. Click any tool name to see a live example on the examples page.
